segments.show: One benign enzyme review task, no patient or efficacy claim.

segments.title: Request and constraints
segments.show: Explicit numbering, protected sites, supported goal and approved limits.

segments.title: Actual Meta to MCP call
segments.show: Actual provider/model, concise decision, tool call and real ESM artifact.

segments.title: Constraint or recovery branch
segments.show: Real changed condition; server rejects unauthorized work; Meta selects a permitted next action.

segments.title: Reviewable output
segments.show: Deterministic shortlist, evidence, unknown phenotype, actual or unknown cost, exports.

segments.title: Measured evidence or explicit limitation
segments.show: Actual fixed/agent comparison on defined tasks; say not measured if missing.

segments.show: What was built in event, reusable MCP tools, reproducibility and scientific limit.
